attribution.processing: Projection, topology-preserving simplification, Antarctica omitted. Moscow city/oblast internal IDs normalized by source feature name; original IDs remain in sourceId. Crimea/Sevastopol excluded from the Russia regional layer. The corresponding 50m Crimea polygon is identified using 10m admin-1 geometry and transferred intact from Russia to Ukraine, preserving the world layer's coastline. Other country geometries unchanged.
